name: patch C: day/night follows live ILL at boot
md5_note: the md5s above are for the owner's installed build, which carries the language string tables (a separate build; tools/strings/i18n is not in the repo). The patch C code bytes are identical for any string tables, but the whole-file md5 depends on them: tools/build_payload.py --daynight with tables_final.json gives cf3cb416b72f7fb4d576e95095c2b7a7 (code identical, string/data bytes differ). patch.sh accepts any payload whose .md5 sidecar matches.

changes.meaning: in SetupExec::loadSystemSettings restore path, replaces `blx systemDimmerState; blx exec_dimmer_state_only` with a call to the cave
cave in the branch patch B made dead: push {r3,lr}; r0=systemDimmerState(); if r0==0xa6 {exec_dimmer_state(0xa5)} else {exec_dimmer_state_only(r0)}; pop {r3,pc}

effect: a saved night state is no longer restored on boot: it is reset to day (level doubled, saved), then the existing tail sets night again only if ILL reads on
build: python3 -I tools/apply_daynight.py <installed patch B payload> <outdir>   (or tools/build_payload.py ... --daynight for a from-stock build)
delivery: nvm library override (tools/usb-patch/x3patch); undo = reinstall the previous payload (saved by patch.sh as previous_libinfomodule.so.<ts>) or mode=uninstall (back to stock, which also drops patch B and the strings)
evidence: assembly (disassembly of the built file checked, only 31 bytes differ); installed 2026-10-26, owner reports Test 1 and Test 2 correct, DimmerState/DimmerLevel flips seen in snapshots (FINDINGS 15.9)
known_risk: if the ILL shadow (libapis 0x41dc680c) is still 0 when the tail runs and the first 0x37 also changes another bit, lights-on at start-up can stay day until the switch is toggled (FINDINGS 15.4 item 3)
